findings.current: I clenched my teeth and increased my speed.
findings.defect: The draft changes Taekyung biting his lip into clenching his teeth.
findings.rationale: 입술을 질끈 깨문 explicitly describes biting down on his lip, not clenching his teeth.
findings.replacement: I bit down hard on my lip and increased my speed.
findings.source: 입술을 질끈 깨문 나는 속도를 더욱 높였다.

findings.current: “They’re just not here. There are survivors somewhere much farther away than this. I know it.”
findings.defect: The draft turns Taekyung’s claim that the survivors are merely not visible into the stronger claim that they are not present.
findings.rationale: 보이지 않을 뿐이야 means they merely cannot be seen; it does not itself assert their complete absence from the present area.
findings.replacement: “We just can’t see them. There are survivors somewhere much farther away than this. I know it.”
findings.source: “보이지 않을 뿐이야. 이곳보다 훨씬 더 먼 어딘가에 생존자가 있어. 분명히.”

findings.current: They were making a desperate effort, but their numbers were woefully inadequate compared to the number of people who needed to be rescued.
findings.defect: The draft makes the rescuers’ head count inadequate, while the source says their desperate effort and available response are insufficient for the number of lives at risk.
findings.rationale: The implied subject of 턱없이 부족하다 is the preceding 필사적인 노력, not specifically the rescuers’ numerical strength.
findings.replacement: They were making a desperate effort, but it was woefully inadequate for the number of people who needed rescuing.
findings.source: 그들로서는 필사적인 노력이겠지만, 구해야 하는 인명의 숫자에 비해서는 턱없이 부족하다.

findings.current: No one answered. There were only rigid faces and the sound of our pace quickening.
findings.defect: The draft adds the sound of their acceleration, which the source does not mention.
findings.rationale: 더욱 빨라진 속도 refers directly to their increased speed, not to a sound produced by it.
findings.replacement: No one answered. There were only rigid faces and an even faster pace.
findings.source: 대답은 없었다. 딱딱하게 굳은 얼굴들과 더욱 빨라진 속도만이 있을 뿐.

findings.current: Shock and anger spread rapidly. Curses poured down from every side, accompanied by hostile, killing-intent-filled gazes.
findings.defect: The phrasing is unnatural and weakens the established term 살기 by splitting it into an awkward compound modified by the added adjective “hostile.”
findings.rationale: 온갖 means all manner of, while 살기 어린 시선들 naturally means gazes filled or brimming with killing intent.
findings.replacement: Shock and anger spread rapidly. All manner of curses poured in from every side, along with gazes brimming with killing intent.
findings.source: 충격과 분노가 빠르게 전염된다. 사방에서 쏟아지는 온갖 욕설과 살기 어린 시선들.

findings.current: As I watched the time limit shrink by the second, I pushed all my internal energy and senses to their peak and ran across Dongting Lake, vast as an open sea.
findings.defect: The draft omits the deliberate repetition that emphasizes Taekyung’s prolonged, desperate search.
findings.rationale: 달리고, 또 달렸다 explicitly repeats the action: he ran and kept running.
findings.replacement: As I watched the time limit shrink by the second, I pushed all my internal energy and senses to their peak and ran and ran across Dongting Lake, vast as an open sea.
findings.source: 시시각각 줄어드는 제한 시간을 바라보며 모든 공력과 감각을 최고조로 끌어올린 채 망망대해와도 같은 동정호를 달리고, 또 달렸다.

summary: One altered physical action and several localized fidelity, register, and emphasis issues.
